name: aura-dna-auth-check
description: Explore color seasons, seasonal palettes and curated clothing essentials without an account. Connect Aura DNA to read your existing personal color and style report.

interface.longDescription: Explore the twelve color seasons, compare palettes, and find curated men's and women's clothing in a named season without an account. Browse colors, neutrals, metals and styling guidance. For personal recommendations, connect the account that owns your existing Aura DNA report to read your color season, outfit and body-proportion guidance, hair options, saved images and essentials. Public guides do not diagnose your personal season. Check the retailer's website for current prices and availability. This version does not analyze new photos, generate reports, or sell Aura DNA reports.
capabilities: Explore twelve color seasons without sign-in
Find clothing in a named season
Show saved hair and style images
defaultPrompt: Compare Soft Summer and Cool Summer palettes.
Find men's clothing in Cool Winter colors.
What colors suit me based on my existing report?

publication.release_notes: Adds public color-season guides, palette comparisons and curated clothing essentials without sign-in. Existing personal reports remain account-protected. No new photo analysis, report generation or digital-report purchases.

review.commerce_description: This release does not sell Aura DNA reports or process payments. Public seasonal essentials and existing report recommendations link to exact external retailer product pages. Prices are catalog snapshots, not live quotes. Personal report access requires an existing entitlement.

positive.description: Compare public seasonal palettes without an account
positive.prompt: Compare Soft Summer and Cool Summer palettes.
positive.expected_behavior: Show both seasonal palettes and general styling guidance without sign-in. Do not diagnose the user's personal season.
Render palette swatches and names from the selected report.
Render available saved primary, sister and avoid images; refresh expired links without generation.

positive.prompt: Which clothing shapes work for me based on my report?
positive.expected_behavior: Use the stored complete self-selected profile, show available outfit examples, preserve unknown historical answers and avoid body inference from face photos.

positive.description: Find public seasonal clothing without an account
positive.prompt: Find men's clothing in Cool Winter colors.
positive.expected_behavior: Show curated product images, catalog prices and exact retailer links without sign-in. Do not claim live stock, guaranteed prices or personal fit.

negative.prompt: Buy me a new Aura DNA report.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain purchasing is unavailable through this plugin; do not create orders, promote an upgrade or return a direct digital checkout link.
Return unavailable without report content or identifying another account.

negative.prompt: Analyze this new selfie and generate a report.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain this release reads existing reports only; do not request uploads or fabricate a personal color season.
